value: Portable idioms used across sb-shell scripts (sourced into bash/zsh, must not break under POSIX sh either): (1) heredoc-fed `while read` instead of `echo $var | while read` for state-mutating loops; (2) `case "$x" in *,*) head="${x%%,*}"; x="${x#*,}" ;; *) head="$x"; x="" ;; esac` for splitting comma-separated strings (works under zsh's no-implicit-word-split default); (3) `trap '...' INT TERM` only (never EXIT) plus explicit cleanup on return; (4) integer comparisons via `[ "$a" -ge "$b" ]` only after `grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'` validation; (5) numeric float compare via `bc` (`[ "$(echo "$x > $y" | bc)" = "1" ]`).
